decisions.difficulty: Repeated reassessment revises earlier claims and creates duplicated recommendations.
decisions.existing_rule: Group by the underlying inference, preserve withdrawals and source-assisted diagnosis, never count agreeing reports as mathematical evidence.
decisions.application: Read each full sequence; keep withdrawn sqrt/existing-content criticisms distinct from remaining navigation concerns.

decisions.difficulty: More opening evidence detail can obstruct the mechanism it is meant to justify.
decisions.existing_rule: Rank opening obligations by the reader next decision; each addition displaces material; exact evidence belongs beside its scope.
decisions.application: Reorder existing expert explanation and replace overloaded contribution prose; do not add another generic roadmap.

decisions.difficulty: Naming an address or amplifier does not teach the operation the learner must perform.
decisions.existing_rule: Work backward from consequential uses; teach a small operation before using it, and preserve the chosen audience.
decisions.application: Concrete answer-vector to certificate-cell operation and reusable conclusions through the quantum route.

decisions.difficulty: A strong state-level proof can precede the weaker measured-output contract its consumer needs.
decisions.existing_rule: Assess full route and entry shortcuts separately; defer derivations only after stating and locating all contracts.
decisions.application: State exact measured-label law and all-input cap before detailed successful-state geometry; preserve both proofs.

decisions.difficulty: A source link may display an old status comment even though later receipts have narrower recorded passes.
decisions.existing_rule: Bind status to exact sources and individual declaration checks, preserve historical editions and explicit limits.
decisions.application: Verify the historical header and current correspondence; clarify at the paper landing. Do not relabel unchanged source or receipt inventory as fresh execution.

decisions.difficulty: Possessing an annex or being sent a duplicate archive may be mistaken for new source comparison.
decisions.existing_rule: Do not equate access with reading; match edition and mathematical setting; retain the passage and decision it informed.
decisions.application: Hash-compare both supplied archives to annex originals; record seven bounded primary-source comparisons separately from the 100-file integrity audit.

propagation_decision: already_propagated_verified: the existing public owners explicitly require these decisions; no new universal rule or duplicate checklist is warranted. Apply the rules to the papers and preserve this task-specific evidence in the existing review owner.
